en.headline: Hong Kong Tourism Board launches Gourmet Month with over 400 venues
en.dek: The month-long campaign running through 30 November features limited-time menus and promotions at restaurants and bars across the city.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board has launched Hong Kong Gourmet Month, a campaign running throughout November that brings together more than 400 restaurants, bars and food outlets.

The initiative follows the Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival and includes five themed experiences covering award-winning restaurants, neighbourhood eateries, late-night dining, cocktails and the Lan Kwai Fong area. Participating venues offer limited-time menus and promotions.

According to the Tourism Board, the campaign aims to encourage both residents and visitors to explore different districts for dining options from lunch through late night. Details of participating outlets are available through the Board’s channels.

zh.headline: 旅發局推出香港美食月 逾400間餐廳酒吧參與
zh.dek: 為期一個月的活動至11月30日止，全城餐廳及酒吧推出限定菜單及優惠。
body: 香港旅遊發展局推出「香港美食月」，整個11月聯合全港超過400間餐廳、酒吧及餐飲商戶，呈獻期間限定美餵及優惠。
活動緊接香港美酒佳餚巡禮，設有五大主題體驗，涵蓋得獎食府、地區美食、宵夜、雞尾酒及蘭桂坊等。參與商戶提供限定菜單及推廣。
旅發局表示，活動希望鼓勵市民及旅客由午市至深夜深入各區尋味。有關參與商戶詳情可透過旅發局渠道查閱。
